describe.description: The image shows a single quadrupedal equine animal in right-facing side profile against a plain off-white background. The body is slender and donkey-like in proportions with a long neck, narrow torso, and thin legs, covered in short coarse hair that is light tan to gray-brown on the upper body and paler cream on the belly and lower legs. Dark brown to blackish striping overlays the coat on the neck, torso, hindquarters and legs. The head is held high, the tail hangs low at the rear, and all four legs are visible standing on a flat surface. The rendering is detailed and naturalistic, like a vintage zoological illustration.
